card.name: Space before a quantity number
card.fires_on: The space just before a number with a unit (mg, mL, A, W, lm) when the preceding words ask for an amount, such as "maintained on", "more than", "maximum total volume of", or "output of".

modes.label: Dose threshold
modes.description: Space after words like "more than", "at least", or "maintained on" that lead into a drug dose.
modes.example: Patients who have been previously maintained on<< >>20 mg or more of prednis

modes.label: Limit or output value
modes.description: Space after "of", "exceed", or "@" before an electrical, light, or volume figure.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning "amount" or "total" and away from weight and height words.
card.plain: It fires at the blank spot where a number with a unit like mg or mL is about to be given as an amount or limit.
